payload.subject: Consolidate CLI verbs into a minimal, memorable command set
payload.name: Consolidate CLI verbs into a minimal, memorable command set
payload.goal: Propose and implement a reduced command vocabulary that collapses redundant verbs while preserving capability. Coordinate with bc9c51e0 (termination unification): adopt a single lifecycle create->approve->start->finish with --disposition for expedition/mission; unify validate/verify/govern into 'check' (--dry-run|--full, --repair); unify status/checkpoint/explain status/report into 'status'; unify init/bootstrap/genesis/discover/migrate into 'init'. Deliverable: command-map migration plan + deprecated-alias shims + docs update.
